notes.notes: Minor patch update to fix the black screen bug that would occur when entering Chapter 3 while the Halloween or Christmas holiday events were active.

notes.title: The Eyes of Ara version 1.5 update
notes.notes:
What's this, a new patch for The Eyes of Ara? That's right! Patch 1.5 is now live, and with it comes a few optimizations and improvements:

[h2]FPS Limiter[/h2]
A new [b]Limit Frame Rate[/b] option added to the Display Settings. This will allow you to cap the frame rate to your desired limit (or unlimited), such as when syncing the FPS to your monitor's refresh rate.

The first time you load the game after downloading the patch this will default to 60fps.

[h2]Engine Update[/h2]
The game has been updated to use the latest version of Unity. Visually you shouldn't notice anything different, but this does bring with it a bunch of performance optimizations under the hood, so users running on older PCs may experience improved performance.

[h2]Puzzle Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chapter 1: The six-tile ceiling puzzle has been changed to only require the tiles to be rotated into the correct orientation, and no longer requires this to also be done [i]in the correct order[/i]. A small change that should make this early-game puzzle less confusing (and save me from answering emails about this until the end of time).
[*] Chapter 3: The laboratory PC's display has been updated to make it more obvious that two steps are required to unlock the PC.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4 - The Explorer’s Journal
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567425/3d60626a53802be7255d17a05da56991c233371d.jpg[/img]

[b]Patch 1.4[/b] is now live, and with it comes a handy new and often requested feature - the [b]Explorer's Journal[/b].

Whenever you read a book/note/PC/etc, a copy of it will be stored for easy access at any time in that chapter. Simply click the book icon on the left hand side of the inventory bar to bring up the Journal UI. From here you can look through all the books and notes you have found in the chapter!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567425/558782ff817e10e895431da06ea194bd471f7dea.jpg[/img]

In addition, certain clues found throughout each chapter will also be automatically added as notes in the Journal after you locate them in game, reducing the amount of hand scribbled notes you need to keep lying around ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567425/4568a5e3623507ab78663357bfff1372bc6fca2a.jpg[/img]

This update also includes a few other bug fixes and changes (including, you may have noticed, a new logo and desktop icon!) read below for the full patch notes.


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Explorer’s Journal added. After a book/note/etc has been read once it will be accessible via the Journal while within that chapter. Click the book icon on the left side of the UI to open the Journal UI, or use the J hotkey.
[*]Increased texture resolution of inventory item icons.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the text on the laboratory PC in Chapter 3 to more clearly indicate the two steps necessary to access it.
[*]Added visual markers to the concentric circle puzzle in the sewer to aid with alignment.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]New logo and desktop icon!
[*]Scene file size optimisations
[*]Other minor tweaks and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.00 - The World Traveler's Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567425/6cd5bfcd4c0c4ade09585c27e8344d8912c6891e.jpg[/img]

[b]Patch 1.3.00[/b] is now live! And with it comes support for a whole host of new and often requested languages. Read the full patch notes below:

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]New Languages Supported[/b]
Added support for:
[list]
[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]Spanish
[*]Brazilian-Portuguese
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Korean
[*]Japanese
[/list]

Languages can be switched in the Display Settings from the main menu.

In addition, the [b]Castle Maps DLC is available in all supported languages[/b], including German and Russian which were introduced in patch 1.2.00.


[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the zoom range of books
[*]Changed the code sheet in the gem room in Chapter 3 to use symbols rather than letters (this should help players playing the game in non-latin based languages)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing the text on some in-game PC screens to not display correctly.
[*]Fixed inconsistent fonts when playing the game in some languages.
[/list]

notes.title: The Eyes of Ara patch 1.2.00 - Russian and German Localisation
notes.notes:
Good news! The two most requested translations for The Eyes of Ara are now available. [b]Russian[/b] and [b]German[/b] speaking players can now enjoy the game in their native language. A big thanks to Alexander Preymak for the Russian translation, and Nina Neuwirth for the German translation.

Along with the new languages, this patch also includes a few minor tweaks and fixes, full details as follows:

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Added dust mote particles to many rooms
[*]Game window will no longer minimize when clicking outside of the game window
[*]Camera will no longer auto-rotate when mousing outside of the game window, such as onto a second monitor.
[*]Mac: Mousing over the edge of the screen will no longer cause the dock to appear
[/list]

[b]Localisation[/b]
[list]
[*]Russian and German translations now available. Languages can be switched in the Display settings from the main menu.
[/list]

[b]Demo[/b]
[list]
[*]The Eyes of Ara Free Demo has also been updated with all of this patch’s features, including the translations.
[/list]

notes.title: The Eyes of Ara patch 1.1.00 - Helpful Hints
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567425/f620178b4d3ae9ca09727ec22b41629fd3bbde0c.jpg[/img]

I have always thought of The Eyes of Ara as a game of two parts. The first part being the main story line and critical path of puzzles, and the second being the hunt for all of the bonus pickups.

My design philosophy for the first part was that [i]solving[/i] the puzzles should be the challenge, not [i]finding[/i] them, and so all of the rooms in the game are designed to draw the player’s attention to the most important elements. Conversely, the bonus pickups [i]are[/i] designed to be hidden (indeed I often used tricks with the art and room designs to misdirect attention [i]away[/i] from hidden pickups). I’m a big fan of hidden collectables, but understanding that not everyone shares the desire to seek out that elusive 100% completion score I made these completely optional.

It has been great to see that a lot more people have been determined to find all of the pickups than I anticipated. However some of the pickups can be particularly hard to locate, and on dark or high-contrast screens a few have proved to be very difficult to see. Given that everyone has a different level of patience for how long they are willing to search for hidden pickups, these two things combined means that (understandably) some players become frustrated with the pickup hunt.

Patch 1.1.00 aims to rectify this with new Hint Settings added to the Gameplay Settings menu. From top to bottom they are designed to give progressively stronger hints for finding hidden pickups.
[list]
[*][b]Adaptive Hotspot Cursor:[/b] Causes the mouse cursor to change to a magnifying lens when mousing over a hotspot. This option has been available since launch and has simply been renamed in this patch. On by default.
[*][b]Hidden Pickup Chime:[/b] Play a sound when entering a room with hidden pickups still to find. Off by default.
[*][b]Pickup Highlight:[/b] Causes pickups to have a gold shine effect pass over them, making them easier to spot. Includes individual settings for Inventory items and Hidden Pickups (coins, figurines, and photos only). Off by default.
[/list]
In addition, many puzzles and pickups have been re-lit to accommodate dark and/or high-contrast screens. There’s a few other changes in this update as well, read the full patch notes below.


[h1]1.1.00 Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Greatly optimised the file size of many assets. This has reduced load times significantly, as well as reducing the download and install size.
[/list]
[b]Puzzles[/b]
[list]
[*]Re-lit many hidden pickups throughout the game that were difficult to see on dark/high-contrast screens or in bad lighting conditions.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Hint options to Gameplay Settings
[*]Added a Gamma Slider in the Graphics Settings.
[*]The Up and Down arrows on the keyboard can now be used to zoom in on notes and journals. This change should help players without a scroll wheel, such as those using trackballs or touch pads.
[/list]
[b]Localisation[/b] (Because I know you will ask :P )
This patch also includes a lot of back-end code to support localisation into other languages. All of this is invisible to the user, but it means that the game is now ready for language options to be switched on once the text files themselves have been translated.

notes.title: The Eyes of Ara patch 1.0.03 - New Invert Camera options and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
The ability to invert the X and Y axis of the camera independently is a feature that a lot of people have been asking for. I admit it was probably a mistake implementing this the way I did, and I should have split them from the very start, so I apologize.

For those wondering why it was done the way it was, the answer is it wasn’t actually an oversight: The idea behind the camera controls is that you are clicking-and-dragging to drag the view around, just as you click-and-drag objects in the world to manipulate them, and click-and-drag items from your inventory. So the default setting had you dragging the camera around as well, while the “invert” option effectively made you drag the view, in a way this creates an extra layer or separation between the game and the player. It was never meant to function like an FPS mouse look, which removes the click-and-drag layer and has the player’s mouse represent the camera movement directly.

In hindsight, this clearly confused people and I will happily admit that it was a mistake. With the change in this latest patch you can check any combination of Invert X and Y. Both off or both on will function as before, while checking only one will allow you to play using something closer to more traditional FPS style manipulation.

Also included in this patch are a few minor bug fixes for things that have been discovered since launch. Read the full patch notes below:

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Puzzles[/b]
[list]
[*]Turned off the hotspots for the three ship’s wheels in Chapter three once all three lights on the fourth wheel are active. This should help to provide some more feedback that you’re on the right track while working on this puzzle.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Split Invert Camera into separate check boxes for X and Y
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the volume of the Eyes’ flyby sound effects.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a note in Astra’s room not being readable (this note automatically turns off after solving the puzzle in the bathroom, but a bug was causing it not to be readable prior to this either).
[*]Fixed the lever puzzle in the Chapter 2 hallway being useable before the lever is actually inserted
[*]Fixed the planetarium projector misbehaving the first time it is used after loading the game in certain circumstances. 
[*]Fixed water in the sewers not displaying
[*]Fixed some spelling and grammar errors
[/list]

notes.title: The Eyes of Ara patch 1.0.02 - Skippable Paintings
notes.notes:
The three painting puzzles in Chapter 2 have proven to be a contentious issue. While some people have found them simple and logical to solve, others have found them to be a frustrating stopping point. The problem is that while the goal is obvious, the process itself can be quite difficult. I certainly don’t want people giving up on a game that they otherwise enjoy simply because these types of puzzles don’t click with them, so in answer to this concern patch 1.0.02 introduces a means to bypass these puzzles.

Each of the paintings now includes a four-digit code spinner. To bypass the puzzle simply locate the correct code and enter it into the spinner.

Full Patch Notes:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added an a means of bypassing the three painting puzzles in chapter 2.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Prevented the centre spinning disk in the main hall from becoming a perpetual motion machine that would never stop.
    [*]Various other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: The Eyes of Ara patch 1.0.01
notes.notes:
Along with a few minor fixes here and there, the first Eyes of Ara patch brings with it a much requested (and shamefully overlooked on my part) feature: windowed mode! Yes, you can now move the game window to a different monitor without the need to go through the launcher or by using obscure windows hotkeys.

Also, the Hotspot Helper is now turned on by default (toggle this Off in the Gameplay settings), as is VSync (to prevent your PC fan spinning out of control due to excessively good performance ;) ).

Full patch notes as follows:

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a few spelling errors
[*]Removed “See page 162” from the Generator Manual. This is the tutorial, we don’t need red herrings this early on.
[*]Slightly increased the "win" tolerance of the rings in the sewer to make this puzzle a little easier.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed how the gate in the Planetarium updates its state to prevent players being unable to progress in the event of a crash or game closure during the cutscene.
[*]Fixed an error in the History & Legend book text that had the directions for solving one of the puzzles reversed. Sorry about that :)
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Fullscreen option to the Display Settings (accessible through the Title Screen menu), allowing users to toggle Windowed mode.
[*]Opening the Item Viewer will now disable the Keyboard Interface if it is also shown.
[*]Vsync is now turned On by default
[*]Hotspot Helper Cursor is now turned On by default
[/list]
